app.name: PictoCard
app.short_description: Send PictoCards by email or to a Wii.
app.long_description:
Create a picture greeting card on your Wii and send it by email, or send a letter to a Wii Message Board with WiiLink - just like on pictocard.net.
Pick any photo from your SD card or USB drive, add a Mii from your Wii, choose a font and color, and preview the card before it's sent.
Works with the Wii Remote (pointer and buttons), Nunchuk, Classic Controller, GameCube controller, Wii U GamePad and Pro Controller, DualShock 3, and a USB keyboard.
Needs an Internet connection. https://pictocard.net
